statement: The blood-brain barrier is substantially intact in much of a glioblastoma, particularly at the infiltrating margin where recurrence arises, despite contrast enhancement in the tumour core.

measurement.assay: imaging and drug distribution studies reviewed
measurement.endpoint: barrier integrity and drug penetration across the tumour
measurement.effect: enhancement marks disruption in the core; the margin remains protected

replication.note: A critical review synthesising imaging and pharmacological studies.

drift: The assumption that the barrier is broken in glioblastoma has justified systemic trials of drugs that never reached the cells that matter.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
